about: The prayer professes that through Christ God continually creates all these things as good, sanctifies them, gives them life, blesses them, and gives them to us. The relative “quem” refers to Christ, named at the end of the preceding prayer.

s01.translation: Through Him, Lord, You always create all these things as good,

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Use of the Laity (1853)

s02.narrative: The priest makes three signs of the cross over the Host and chalice together.

s03.translation: sanctify them, give them life, bless them, and give them to us.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Use of the Laity (1853)

w002.explanation: Quem refers to Christ, named at the end of the preceding prayer.
